    from collections import Counter

{
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    divider_colors = {grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows} | {grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols}
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x not in divider_colors)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker = next(x for x, _ in counts.most_common() if x != bg)
    rb = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    cb = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(rb)-1):
        row = []
        for ci in range(len(cb)-1):
            r0, r1 = rb[ri]+1, rb[ri+1]
            c0, c1 = cb[ci]+1, cb[ci+1]
            # A cell with a neighboring pair of marks is the selected tile.
            pair = any(grid[r][c] == marker and grid[r][c+1] == marker
                       for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1-1))
            row.append(1 if pair else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out
